cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

# Generated by `qpm restore` — defines COMPILE_ID, MOD_ID, MOD_VERSION,
# EXTERN_DIR, SHARED_DIR, recurse_files(), and the arm64-v8a NDK toolchain.
include(qpm_defines.cmake)

project(${COMPILE_ID})

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)              # beatsaber-hook 9.x requires C++23
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

add_compile_options(-frtti -fexceptions -O3)
add_compile_definitions(VERSION="${MOD_VERSION}")
add_compile_definitions(MOD_ID="${MOD_ID}")

# paperlog trims this many chars off __FILE__ in log output
string(LENGTH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/" FOLDER_LENGTH)
add_compile_definitions(PAPER_ROOT_FOLDER_LENGTH=${FOLDER_LENGTH})

set(SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
recurse_files(cpp_file_list ${SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp)
recurse_files(c_file_list   ${SOURCE_DIR}/*.c)

add_library(${COMPILE_ID} SHARED ${cpp_file_list} ${c_file_list})

target_include_directories(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE -llog)

# Generated by `qpm restore` — wires up all qpm dependency includes + .so links.
include(extern.cmake)
